text:
Anna (Design): Hey team — sharing the next iteration of the latency/throughput dashboard. Focus: p95 chart, heatmap, time-range picker, and sampling controls. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/latency-dashboard

Miguel (Product): Nice! main thing I care about: can we make p95 the default but make p99 easy to toggle? customers keep asking for both.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): p95 default is fine. question: how expensive is computing p99 on every series for long time ranges?

Mark (Eng-ML): p99 can be heavy if we do exact aggregation across high-cardinality routes. We should support an approximate p99 via sampling + reservoir algorithm, and only compute exact p99 for selected routes.

Anna (Design): Good to know. UI idea: p95 primary line, small secondary p99 dotted line. Add a tooltip: "p99 shown in approximate mode for ranges > 24h". Thoughts?

Miguel (Product): Love the tooltip. Also add a tiny badge near the selector: "Approx when sampled". Helps surface the tradeoff.

Jules (Accessibility): Color contrast note: the dotted p99 line in current palette is too light for low-vision users. Please ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 against the chart background. Also keyboard focus for the chart series toggles.

Anna (Design): Agreed. I'll bump the p99 color and add focus rings.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Heatmap question: we're showing request density over time vs latency buckets. Do we sample the requests for the heatmap or use aggregated counters?

Mark (Eng-ML): For performance, use aggregated counters per bucket per minute. We can expose sampling controls to adjust bucket resolution and sampling frequency.

Anna (Design): Proposed control copy: "Sampling: Auto / Low / Medium / High" with a ? tooltip: "Lower sampling reduces query cost; higher sampling improves accuracy for tail metrics." Any better wording?

Miguel (Product): Maybe: "Sampling level — Adjust data fidelity vs cost". Keep short in the UI.

Jules (Accessibility): Make sure the sampling control has an aria-describedby linking to the tooltip text. Also avoid color-only indicators for sampling state.

Anna (Design): Noted. I'll add a text label and an icon + accessible name.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Time range picker: default options should be Last 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, Custom. For custom ranges we should clamp the max to 90d and show a warning about downsampled data.

Anna (Design): Adding a small inline hint under the picker: "Data older than 24h may be sampled". For custom ranges, a modal with explicit confirmation if >90d.

Mark (Eng-ML): For long ranges the heatmap should switch to coarser buckets automatically. Maybe expose a toggle: "Auto-aggregate for long ranges" (on by default).

Miguel (Product): Agree. Also, can we add a little sparkline next to each route in the route list (mini p95) so customers can scan hot routes quickly?

Sofia (Eng-Platform): We can generate sparklines from precomputed aggregates, cheap. We'll need a rate limit on how many routes we fetch at once.

Anna (Design): UI nit: chart legend ordering — put active/selected series first, then the rest. Also allow reordering via drag in the legend for power users.

Jules (Accessibility): Drag-to-reorder isn't great for keyboard users. If we add reordering, provide an alternate "Move up / Move down" action in the legend menu.

Anna (Design): Good call — I'll include both.

design-bot: New design updated in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/latency-dashboard (version 4) — comments enabled.

Miguel (Product): Quick UX copy tweak: change "Sampling" label to "Data fidelity" in the compact view. "Sampling" can be developer-y.

Anna (Design): Will try both in A/B — compact view shows "Fidelity" and tooltip says "Sampling level".

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Implementation note: expose a query param for sampling level and a header for strict/exact mode so customers on Dedicated can request exact p99 if they accept load.

Mark (Eng-ML): Also add a server-side feature flag to allow exact tail queries for enterprise customers.

Anna (Design): OK I'll update the mocks with these notes: color, focus, legend reorder, time range wording, sampling copy variants, and accessibility hooks. I'll ping when figma v4.1 is up.

Miguel (Product): Thanks! Please include a tiny changelog in the Figma comments about behavior changes (auto-aggregate, approximate p99 rules).

Jules (Accessibility): I'll do a quick pass after the update for keyboard and ARIA checks.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): I'll prototype the sampling query param and a cheap reservoir p99. Expect a PR next week.

Anna (Design): Great. If nobody objects, I'll merge these into the next Console sprint ticket. :thumbsup:

Miguel (Product): :thumbsup:

Mark (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:
